opening.argument: The speaker presents a cryptocurrency as a way to make money, claiming viewers can earn up to 40% per month by keeping their coins. He adds a referral program that rewards inviting friends with more coins and separately promotes PC mining as a way to earn more while using less electricity. Interested viewers are directed to external links for further information. These unusually high monthly returns, referral incentives, and solicitation through links create a clear appeal for participation in an investment or staking opportunity. The speaker denies that it is a Ponzi scheme, but that denial does not remove the financial inducements being presented.
